data.body:
INVESTIGATION COMPLETE (INTERMEDIATE, opus) — ac06 premise INVALIDATED; NO code fix applied (leaving open per rule:bug-close-with-code; routing disposition to 588e review panel).

FINDING: 29e7-c612-706d-42bc is NOT a phantom. It is a legitimately CLOSED story (parent_id 588e; alias wiry-gate-clique; 'sg-based dangling-reference matcher'; landed PR1 #631→PR2 #632). Its CREATE was compacted into a SNAPSHOT (ticket-compact.sh deletes source LINK/CREATE files after baking into compiled_state) — hence the earlier 'no CREATE / exists=false' symptom at filing time. NOW: ticket exists→0, ticket show→real closed story.

IMPACT IS MOOT (empirically verified on live store):
- 3ee4 readiness: real open deps are 1b76 + c9e9 (the two fail-opens). 29e7 + a85d/7b77/2730/0cd7/3783 are all CLOSED. _graph.py computes ready_to_work via _get_ticket_status, which treats closed/deleted as SATISFIED. 29e7 does NOT wedge 3ee4.
- 3ebb readiness: only non-closed depends_on is cca8 (in_progress, admin DD2). 7b77+29e7 closed. 29e7 does NOT wedge 3ebb.
- 588e closure: 29e7 is a CLOSED child = completed; does not block closure. Non-closed children are 3ebb/3ee4/830c/cca8.
- No consumer gates on the blockers[] field (grep: none outside tests/graph) — so _find_direct_blockers listing 29e7 is purely cosmetic.

TWO RESIDUAL (genuine but non-load-bearing) sub-defects found:
(1) COSMETIC: _find_direct_blockers (ticket_graph/_blockers.py:48-61) lists a depends_on target as a blocker unless archived is True — never checks status==closed via _get_ticket_status. So blockers[] includes satisfied (closed) deps. ready_to_work is unaffected (it re-checks status), and no consumer reads blockers[] as a gate. Optional correctness cleanup.
(2) LATENT: ticket-compact.sh bakes LINK edges into SNAPSHOT deps[] and deletes source LINK files, but ticket-link.sh unlink (_get_link_info) only globs *-LINK.json → compacted dep edges are unremovable via unlink. Blocks nothing (a closed dep is harmless). Candidate for a separate follow-up bug; safe existing tooling for removal exists (ticket-delete-unlink-scan.py keys UNLINK on snapshot link_uuid) but deleting 29e7 is contraindicated (real completed child the 588e manifest needs).

DISPOSITION (for panel/maintainer): ac06's load-bearing problem is gone. Options: (A) close ac06 as resolved-by-state-change (29e7 closed) + file (2) as a separate latent-hardening bug; (B) additionally land cosmetic fix (1) under ac06 then close; (C) close ac06 as not-a-bug. Recommend A. NOT closing autonomously — no code change + premise reframe needs maintainer/panel sign-off.
